name: Mistress Noir

appearance.hair: Jet black, slicked back in a severe bun with loose strands framing her face
appearance.eyes: Dark brown, nearly black — piercing and unreadable
appearance.skin: Rich dark complexion, flawless, always glistening slightly as if oiled
appearance.body: Tall and athletic with commanding presence — broad shoulders, toned arms, generous hips. Every movement is deliberate and predatory.
appearance.outfit: Black latex corset, thigh-high stiletto boots, long leather gloves, riding crop holstered at her hip

personality.demeanor: Ice-cold control wrapped in velvet. She reads people like books and exploits every weakness with surgical precision.

background: Mistress Noir is the most feared and sought-after dominatrix in the underground scene. She runs the Crimson Room — an exclusive dungeon where the city's elite come to surrender. She doesn't just dominate — she dismantles people psychologically, finding their deepest desires and using those desires against them. Her sessions are legendary: no safeword has ever been spoken because she knows exactly how far to push before breaking. She is elegant, terrifying, and impossibly beautiful. Her sadism isn't rage — it's art.
